_readme: Game database. Title IDs marked verified:false are from memory/community lists - ALWAYS confirm with 'Scan USB' (the ID your own console uses wins). Add games from the app (Game tab > Add game) or edit this file.

games.name: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot
games.pc_save_hint: ManualSave0, ManualSave1, ... (one file per slot, 4,529,808 bytes each)
games.notes: The game encrypts its own saves (AES, 16-byte blocks). The converter doesn't decrypt them. It checks the files, then compares them with your PS4 export to see if both use the same key. Same key = drop-in compatible. Each slot (ManualSave0, ManualSave1...) is its own save on the PS4, so convert one slot at a time into its matching Apollo export folder.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto V
games.notes: EXPERIMENTAL: GTA V PC and PS4 saves are not byte-identical. The generic converter only copies/renames - a game-specific converter plugin is needed for a working save.
